title: Foraging Snails on the Murgia: A Childhood Tradition from Southern Italy

body.content: Snails are one of those foods that tend to divide opinion. Many vegetarians and vegans may find the idea unappealing, and even among omnivores they are certainly not to everyone's taste. Yet for my parents, who were true lovers of good food, snails were considered a delicacy and were a regular feature on our family table.
